The D*C Website lists the Constructed deck tournament as beginning
in "Session 3: Thursday 18:00 - 22:00" and continuing into
"Session 4: Thursday 22:00 - 02:00".

For the Sabbat Draft, it lists sessions 10, 11 (Saturday 1300 - 2200)
with finals at session 13 (Sunday at 0900).

The Jyhad Sealed tournament is listed as being in sessions 6 and 7
(Friday, beginning at 1300).

> I was also trying to find out if anything else
> was going to definitely be scheduled (ie, Todd's constructed tournament).

So I pointed out that the D*C website did not have any information
about such tournaments, FWIW.
